mapper.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT vr.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY vr.work_id ORDER BY vr.viewed_on,vr.created_at,vr.id) AS viewing_order FROM viewing_record vr WHERE vr.user_id=#{userId})

r.id,r.work_id AS workId,r.viewed_on AS viewedOn,r.rating,r.review,r.created_at AS createdAt,r.updated_at AS updatedAt,r.version,r.viewing_order AS viewingOrder,w.title,w.media_type AS mediaType,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(g.name ORDER BY g.name SEPARATOR ' · ') FROM work_genre wg JOIN genre g ON g.id=wg.genre_id WHERE wg.work_id=w.id) AS genreNames, (SELECT p.rating FROM ranked p WHERE p.work_id=r.work_id AND p.viewing_order < r.viewing_order AND p.rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.viewing_order DESC LIMIT 1) AS previousRating

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM work_genre wg WHERE wg.work_id=r.work_id AND wg.genre_id=#{q.genreId})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked r JOIN work w ON w.id=r.work_id
SELECT FROM ranked r JOIN work w ON w.id=r.work_id WHERE r.id=#{id}

SELECT w.id AS workId,s.status AS currentState, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM viewing_record v WHERE v.user_id=#{userId} AND v.work_id=w.id) AS recordCount, (SELECT MAX(v.viewed_on) FROM viewing_record v WHERE v.user_id=#{userId} AND v.work_id=w.id) AS lastViewedOn, (SELECT v.rating FROM viewing_record v WHERE v.user_id=#{userId} AND v.work_id=w.id AND v.rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.viewed_on DESC,v.created_at DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestRating, (SELECT v.viewed_on FROM viewing_record v WHERE v.user_id=#{userId} AND v.work_id=w.id AND v.rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY v.viewed_on DESC,v.created_at DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestRatingOn FROM work w LEFT JOIN user_work_state s ON s.work_id=w.id AND s.user_id=#{userId} WHERE w.id IN #{workId}
mapper.update: UPDATE viewing_record SET viewed_on=#{viewedOn},rating=#{rating},review=#{review},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM viewing_record WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash AS requestHash,record_id AS recordId FROM record_submission WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_token=#{token} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE record_submission SET record_id=#{recordId} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_token=#{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_work_state(user_id,work_id,status) VALUES(#{userId},#{workId},#{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_work_state WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND work_id=#{workId}
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM user_work_state WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND work_id=#{workId}

SELECT s.work_id AS workId,s.status,s.updated_at AS updatedAt,w.title,w.media_type AS mediaType,w.release_year AS releaseYear FROM user_work_state s JOIN work w ON w.id=s.work_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.status=#{status} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC,s.work_id DESC
